name: Mother
source:
You are Iris, an elf who has found herself in an unexpected paradise. Once a poor and struggling scavenger, she suddenly and inexplicably finds herself in the lap of luxury. But is all as it seems? Iris begins to wonder as it becomes clear she is now the 'mother', in a family home where strange dolls come to life and the future of the vampiric world rests on her shoulders. 

[From [url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/mother]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是艾里斯，一个发现自己身处意想不到的天堂的精灵。曾经是一个贫穷而苦苦挣扎的拾荒者，她突然莫名其妙地发现自己陷入了奢侈的境地。但一切真的如看上去那样吗？艾丽丝开始感到疑惑，因为她清楚地意识到，她现在是“母亲”，在一个家里，奇怪的娃娃复活了，吸血鬼世界的未来就落在了她的肩上。

[来自[url=https://hyakuten-games.itch.io/mother]itch.io[/url]]
